parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end time. The maximum interval between StartTime and EndTime cannot exceed 24 hours.

parameters.name: Proto
parameters.description: The request protocol, such as http, https, and tcp.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start time in the format of yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.

parameters.name: VPort
parameters.description: The VIP port, such as 80, 8080, and 443.
